research_subpages.campaign_detail: absent; current campaign is embedded in /

states_inspected: comparison list with all fixture states

global_findings.finding: The dashboard has page-wide horizontal overflow at every inspected width.
global_findings.remediation: Replace the monolithic raw tables with bounded semantic cards and compact responsive tables; keep technical tables in local scroll containers.

global_findings.finding: Raw JSON is the primary representation for decisions, measured outcomes, comparison plans, validity summaries, ratings, blind answers and cost profiles.
global_findings.remediation: Add semantic action, outcome, plan, validity, rating and cost-profile renderers; retain JSON only in keyboard-accessible details.

global_findings.finding: All research domains are compressed into a single 10,525–22,719 px dashboard; campaign, hypothesis, decision, lane, candidate and event pages do not exist.
global_findings.remediation: Introduce bounded read-only domain pages or clearly separated views with pagination and stable navigation.

global_findings.finding: The application is dark-only. There is no theme control and no persisted browser preference.
global_findings.remediation: Provide accessible light and dark themes, a visible toggle, localStorage persistence and a no-flash initial theme script.

global_findings.finding: Prepare, authorize, start and stop controls are shown for completed and historical read-only suites; blind and manual-rating affordances are also shown where there are no valid turns.
global_findings.remediation: Render controls from lifecycle and read-only state, disable impossible operations, and explain why an action is unavailable.

global_findings.finding: Unknown routes use the standard-library server's unstyled default 404 page and lose application navigation.
global_findings.remediation: Render a bounded application error page with status, explanation and recovery links.

global_findings.finding: Form labels and heading hierarchy are generally exposed, but table headers are rendered as ordinary cells, many controls are below 44 px, status depends heavily on text density, and focus treatment is not visibly differentiated.
global_findings.remediation: Use th/scope, visible focus rings, compact but adequate targets, explicit status labels and semantic landmarks.

global_findings.finding: The dashboard repeatedly polls six APIs; no request failed, but the cadence produces a long repeated request log while idle.
global_findings.remediation: Use one bounded refresh interval, pause when the page is hidden, and avoid replacing unchanged DOM.
